code_lines_original: % GPS_SIMULATOR_GUI  Interactive GPS dynamics simulator (MATLAB R2017b+).
%     1. Simulation : 3-D animation of a 24-satellite constellation, pseudorange
%                     lines, user motion, least-squares fix, DOP and error plots.
%     2. Equations  : GPS equations rendered with the LaTeX interpreter.
%     3. MATLAB Code: the MATLAB functions behind each equation, explained.
%   Model simplifications: spherical Earth, circular orbits (Walker 24/6/1,
%   55 deg), constant simple iono delay, user walking on a 100 m circle.
% Walker 24/6/1 layout: 6 planes x 4 satellites, phasing factor F = 1
P.raan = 2*pi*pp(:)'/6;                       % right ascension of each plane
% User: walks on a circle (radius Rpath, period Tpath) in a local ENU frame
P.clk0 = 8.5e-5;  P.clkDrift = 1e-9;          % receiver clock bias [s], drift [s/s]
% ENU basis vectors expressed in ECEF at the user's reference point
sp = sin(P.lat0); cp = cos(P.lat0); sl = sin(P.lon0); cl = cos(P.lon0);
P.Renu = [P.e'; P.n'; P.u'];                  % ECEF -> ENU rotation
% Run-time state (shared with the nested callbacks below)
% ---- Simulation tab: read-out text and control panel ------------------
%  Text objects with 'Interpreter','latex' typeset the formulas.
'2. Geometric range and clock bias term', {
'3. Linearisation about the estimate (Taylor, first order)', {
'$x = a(\cos\Omega\cos u-\sin\Omega\cos i\,\sin u),\ \ y = a(\sin\Omega\cos u+\cos\Omega\cos i\,\sin u),\ \ z=a\sin i\,\sin u$'
'Geometric range r_i = |s_i - x_u| for all satellites at once:'
'    d   = satV - x(1:3);     % 3 x n vectors user -> satellite'
'    r   = vecnorm(d);        % 1 x n Euclidean lengths'
'vecnorm works column-wise, so one call replaces a loop over satellites.'
'norm(dx(1:3)) is used for the convergence test of the solver.'}
'Zero-mean Gaussian measurement noise eps_i with std sigma:'
'The pseudorange = true range + receiver clock term + iono delay + noise.'}
'Elevation angle from the user "up" vector and line of sight:'
'P.u''*los is the dot product for every satellite; asin gives sin(El)^-1.'}
'Normal equations solved with the backslash operator:'
'Preferred over inv(G''*G)*G''*dRho: faster and numerically better.'
'Each iteration x = x + dx moves the estimate closer to the solution'
'Covariance shape matrix of the position solution:'
'Here the explicit inverse is needed because DOP uses its diagonal.'
'Rotating Q(1:3,1:3) with P.Renu yields HDOP and VDOP in East/North/Up.'}
'Circular orbit and ECI -> ECEF conversion in satPositions():'
'th = we*t rotates the inertial frame into the rotating Earth frame.'}
'Typesets the formulas on the Equations tab:'
'Wrap the formula in $...$. Not every LaTeX package is available:'
'Changing XData/YData/ZData of existing lines is far faster than calling'
'plot3 every frame; "limitrate" caps the refresh and keeps buttons responsive.'}
%  SECTION 5 - VISUALIZATION SETUP (3-D scene, ENU plot, error plot)
% ---- 3-D scene: Earth, satellites, trails, pseudorange lines ----------
xlabel(ax3d,'X ECEF [km]'); ylabel(ax3d,'Y ECEF [km]'); zlabel(ax3d,'Z ECEF [km]');
% ---- Local ENU plot: true path vs estimated positions -----------------
title(axENU,'Local ENU: true path (red) vs GPS fixes (blue)');
%  SECTION 6 - CALLBACKS AND SIMULATION LOOP (simulation logic)
% Start/pause toggle. The loop runs inside the callback; drawnow
% lets the Pause/Reset buttons and sliders interrupt it.
running = false;  delete(fig);     % stops the loop, closes window
% ---- advance time and read UI settings ----
if useIono, I = 5*(1 + 16*(0.53 - el/pi).^3); end % simple iono model [m]
enu = P.Renu*(xhat(1:3) - P.p0);          % estimate in ENU about p0
if vis(k)   % pseudorange line user -> satellite
%  SECTION 7 - GUI HELPER (nested so it can use the panel background)
% ECEF positions (3 x N) of circular-orbit satellites at time t. (Eq. 7)
u  = P.M0 + sqrt(P.mu/P.a^3)*t;                 % argument of latitude
cO = cos(P.raan); sO = sin(P.raan); ci = cos(P.inc); si = sin(P.inc);
s  = [cos(th)*x + sin(th)*y; -sin(th)*x + cos(th)*y; z];   % ECI -> ECEF
d    = satV - x(1:3);                       % user -> satellite vectors
% Dilution of precision from the geometry matrix. (Eq. 6)
